newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lafarge says Europe market sluggish.
newsitem.headline: Lafarge says Europe market sluggish.

text.p: Building materials company Lafarge SA said business looked good in North America and emerging markets this year, but continued to be sluggish in Europe.

"In our 1997 trends, we're continuing to show growth in the emerging economies. North America is also favourable. It's positive in the United States, and in Canada, the recovery begun in the middle of 1996 is being confirmed," Chairman Bertrand Collomb told Radio Classique in an interview due to be aired on Saturday.
"In Europe and certainly in France, it's still mediocre but that was to be expected," he said.
Lafarge reported a 19.5 percent rise in 1997 first-quarter sales, but Collomb said the gain was from extremely weak year-earlier levels due to poor weather in the first quarter of 1996.
